title: Peaceful Enhancers
description: Basic essentials you can't earn in peaceful, are now obtainable.
body:
## PEACEFUL ENHANCERS
You enjoy playing in peaceful mode, so creepers don't randomly explode you while mining diamonds? But you also need ender pearls, rotten flesh, spider eyes, and other stuff for crafting and trades?
In this data pack, you can now do both. The following items are obtainable through chests:
- Ender Pearls
- Eyes Of Ender
- Blaze Rods
- Rotten Flesh
- Spider Eyes
- Magma Cream
- Slime Balls
- Piglin Head
- Dragon Head
- Wither Skeleton Head
- Ghast tear
- Nautlius Shell
 
_And more to be added in the future._
  You can also make sticky pistons easier in this mod using cobwebs, and you can also craft certain items (Ender pearls, rotten flesh, slimeballs, magma cream, etc)
Some of these items may not be useful in peaceful, such as eyes of ender and wither skeleton heads. But switching to easy mode subtly just for the ender dragon and wither battles, and then switching back can work.
  Any **suggestions**? Add me on Discord at @notverzee.
